svg.title: How a call reaches a crate: the three bindings over the compiled engine, a Rust program straight to the crates, every capability by chapter, the crates that build on pamoja-core, and the three ways to install.
svg.text: pamoja-ffi over the C ABI: one library carrying every capability
A package narrows the API, not the download.
Rust: cargo add pamoja-<name>, the crates themselves
Transport, Device, Sensor, Actuator, Store, and the event bus
no_std, so it runs on a microcontroller
The names in amber build on it; the rest are pure logic with no dependency.
A chapter's package brings its capabilities with it. Everything
at once: npm install pamoja, pip install pamoja,
dotnet add package Pamoja, or cargo add pamoja.
